arxiv-1607-06919.title: Thermal state truncation by using quantum scissors device
arxiv-1607-06919.creator: Hong-xia Zhao 1 , Xue–xiang Xu 2,† , Hong-chun Yuan 3
arxiv-1607-06919.description: Abstract A non-Gaussian state being a mixture of the vacuum and single-photon states can be generated by truncating a thermal state in a quantum scissors device of Pegg et al. [Phys. Rev. Lett. 81 (1998) 1604]. In contrast to the thermal state, the generated state shows nonclassical property including the negativity of Wigner function.

arxiv-1809-10303.creator: A. Di Ciolo ? {}^{\textsf{\footnotesize{\mbox{?}}}}, A. Avella ? , ? , ?
arxiv-1809-10303.description: Abstract In this review paper, we illustrate a possible route to obtain a reliable solution of the 2D Hubbard model and an explanation for some of the unconventional behaviours of underdoped high- T c T_{\text{c}} cuprate superconductors within the framework of the composite operator method.

arxiv-2107-02416.title: Enhanced Universal Dependency Parsing with Automated Concatenation of Embeddings
arxiv-2107-02416.creator: Xinyu Wang, Zixia Jia, Yong Jiang, Kewei Tu
arxiv-2107-02416.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Xinyu Wang, Zixia Jia, Yong Jiang, Kewei Tu. This paper describes the system used in submission from SHANGHAITECH team to the IWPT 2021 Shared Task . Our system is a graph-based parser with the technique of Automated Concatenation of Embeddings (ACE). Because recent work found that better word representations can be obtained by concatenating different types of embeddings, we use ACE to automatically find the better concatenation of embeddings for the task of enhanced universal dependencies.

arxiv-2411-00599.title: Continuous-variable square-ladder cluster states in a microwave frequency comb
arxiv-2411-00599.creator: Fabio Lingua, J. C. Rivera Hernández, Michele Cortinovis, David B. Haviland
arxiv-2411-00599.description: Abstract We describe an experiment demonstrating the generation of three independent square-ladder continuous-variable cluster states with up to 94 qumodes of a microwave frequency comb. This entanglement structure at a large scale is realized by injecting vacuum fluctuations into a Josephson Parametric Amplifier pumped by three coherent signals around twice its resonance frequency, each having a particular well-defined phase relation.

arxiv-2505-00166.title: On the Invariance of the Real Milnor Number under Asymptotically Lipschitz Equivalence
arxiv-2505-00166.creator: Raphael de Omena, José Edson Sampaio, Emanoel Souza
arxiv-2505-00166.description: Abstract . We investigate sufficient conditions for the invariance of the real Milnor number under ℛ \mathcal{R} -bi-Lipschitz equivalence for function-germs f , g : ( ℝ n , 0 ) → ( ℝ , 0 ) f,g\colon(\mathbb{R}^{n},0)\to(\mathbb{R},0) . More generally, we explore its invariance within the extended framework of ℛ \mathcal{R} -asymptotically Lipschitz equivalence.

arxiv-2507-22946.creator: 1 st Yixuan Mi*, 2 nd Yiduo Yu, 3 rd Yiyi Zhao
arxiv-2507-22946.description: Abstract We present SmartCourse, an integrated course management and AI-driven advising system for undergraduate students (specifically tailored to the Computer Science (CPS) major). SmartCourse addresses the limitations of traditional advising tools by integrating transcript and plan information for student-specific context.

arxiv-2509-04665.title: Nonlocal nucleon-nucleus optical potentials from chiral effective field theory
arxiv-2509-04665.creator: L. M. Stahulak 1 , J. W. Holt 1
arxiv-2509-04665.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by L. M. Stahulak 1 , J. W. Holt 1. We investigate the nonlocality in microscopic optical potentials derived from chiral effective field theory. For this purpose we employ the Perey-Buck ansatz, which connects the energy dependence of purely local optical potentials to a Gaussian spatial nonlocality. We find that the dominant source of energy dependence in the microscopic real optical potential indeed arises from spatial nonlocalities, while the energy dependence associated with the microscopic imaginary optical potential is a genuine time nonlocality.

arxiv-2512-12693.title: Co-Exploration and Co-Exploitation via Shared Structure in Multi-Task Bandits
arxiv-2512-12693.creator: Sumantrak Mukherjee, Serafima Lebedeva, Valentin Margraf, Jonas Hanselle, Kanta Yamaoka, Viktor Bengs, Stefan Konigorski, Eyke Hüllermeier, Sebastian Josef Vollmer
arxiv-2512-12693.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sumantrak Mukherjee, Serafima Lebedeva, Valentin Margraf, Jonas Hanselle, Kanta Yamaoka, Viktor Bengs, Stefan Konigorski, Eyke Hüllermeier, Sebastian Josef Vollmer. We propose a novel Bayesian framework for efficient exploration in contextual multi-task multi-armed bandit settings, where the context is only observed partially and dependencies between reward distributions are induced by latent context variables. In order to exploit these structural dependencies, our approach integrates observations across all tasks and learns a global joint distribution, while still allowing personalised inference for new tasks.

arxiv-2601-12816.title: Fisher-Orthogonal Projected Natural Gradient Descent for Continual Learning
arxiv-2601-12816.creator: Ishir Garg, Neel Kolhe, Andy Peng, Rohan Gopalam
arxiv-2601-12816.description: Abstract Continual learning aims to enable neural networks to acquire new knowledge on sequential tasks. However, the key challenge in such settings is to learn new tasks without catastrophically forgetting previously learned tasks. We propose the Fisher-Orthogonal Projected Natural Gradient Descent (FOPNG) optimizer, which enforces Fisher-orthogonal constraints on parameter updates to preserve old task performance while learning new tasks.

pmc-10576137.title: A scientist’s take on scientific evidence in the courtroom
pmc-10576137.creator: Thomas D. Albright
pmc-10576137.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Scientific evidence is frequently offered to answer questions of fact in a court of law. DNA genotyping may link a suspect to a homicide. Receptor binding assays and behavioral toxicology may testify to the teratogenic effects of bug repellant. As for any use of science to inform fateful decisions, the immediate question raised is one of credibility: Is the evidence a product of valid methods? Are results accurate and reproducible?

pmc-10647846.title: Canine Pyometra: A Short Review of Current Advances
pmc-10647846.creator: Rafael Gariglio Clark Xavier, Clarissa Helena Santana, Yasmin Gonçalves de Castro, Thayanne Gabryelle Viana de Souza, Victor Santos do Amarante, Renato Lima Santos, Rodrigo Otávio Silveira Silva, Jesús Dorado
pmc-10647846.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Simple SummaryPyometra is a common reproductive disease in dogs that often begins with mild symptoms, but if not promptly treated, it can turn into a threat to life. Despite being frequent, the disease is still not fully understood. In the last few years, studies have contributed to a better comprehension of this disease, raising new hypotheses regarding the epidemiology, bacteria involved, the pre-existing uterine lesions that might be associated, and even a possible influence of one’s diet.

pmc-10704862.description: Fasciola hepatica is a parasite with a worldwide distribution that affects several mammals, including humans, and is considered a public health problem. Therefore, the aim of this study was to determine the prevalence of Fasciola hepatica in humans, cattle and sheep, as well as to evaluate factors associated with the prevalence.

pmc-12594845.creator: Ala’a R. Al-Shamasneh, Manish Kewalramani, Arsalan Mahmoodzadeh, Abdulaziz Alghamdi, Jasim Alnahas, Nejib Ghazouani, Mohammed Sulaiman

pmc-12712283.creator: Junjie Ma, Haixin Pei, Fuhang Wang, Deliang Shen
pmc-12712283.description: Traditional drug delivery systems often face problems such as low drug accumulation at the target site, rapid clearance in the body, and potential damage to healthy tissues. pmc-13204633.title: UAV Aeromagnetic Path Planning in Complex Terrain Based on a Q-Learning-Assisted Multi-Strategy Starfish Optimization Algorithm
pmc-13204633.creator: Sihan Yuan, Zhipeng Li, Junjie Zhang
pmc-13204633.description: Low-altitude terrain-following flight is essential for obtaining high-quality data in unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) aeromagnetic surveys, but achieving efficient and safe path planning within complex terrains remains challenging. To address this issue, a Q-learning-assisted multi-strategy Starfish Optimization Algorithm (QMSFOA) is proposed for offline path planning.

pmc-13239783.title: Investigating the structural basis of surfactant protein D oligomerization: The crucial role of Cys15‐Cys15/Cys20‐Cys20 disulfide bond linkage
pmc-13239783.creator: Deng Li, Mona S. Minkara
pmc-13239783.description: Surfactant protein D (SP‐D) plays a vital role in innate immunity by recognizing and binding to glycans on the surfaces of various pathogens. The oligomerization of SP‐D into dodecameric structures enhances its pathogen‐binding and antiviral activities. Central to this oligomerization are two conserved cysteine residues (Cys15 and Cys20) in the N‐terminal domain, which form disulfide bonds essential for assembly.

uslaw-usc-t18-s1730.title: 18 U.S.C. § 1730 — Uniforms of carriers
uslaw-usc-t18-s1730.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t18-s1730.description: United States Code, Title 18 (Crimes And Criminal Procedure); Part I (Crimes); Chapter 83 (Postal Service). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Whoever, not being connected with the letter-carrier branch of the Postal Service, wears the uniform or badge which may be prescribed by the Postal Service to be worn by letter carriers, shall be fined under this title or imprisoned not more.
